findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: A pressed Toggle with the default neutral tone looks exactly like an unpressed one in modern light, aqua light and aqua dark (fill contrast 1.00:1, same text colour), and below 1.25:1 in every other theme.
findings.evidence: Pixel measurement of apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-toggle-themes-chromium-linux.png (points 124,y vs 260,y) and ui-react-toggle-states-chromium-linux.png (1.03:1); packages/ui-react/src/components/toggle/toggle.css:25-31,137-141 fall back to --a63-segment-selected-background (surface-overlay in modern, surface-panel in aqua).
findings.fix: Give standalone Toggle its own pressed fill token (e.g. --a63-selected-background or surface-muted/control-active) that differs from the page by at least 3:1 non-text contrast or add a second cue (weight or border), set per theme; add a check that the pressed and rest baselines differ.

verified.reason: The themes snapshot shows the neutral 'On' toggle with no visible fill and the same text weight and colour as 'Off' in modern/light, aqua/light and aqua/dark. Only modern/dark, retro and terminal show a faint pill. toggle.css:137-141 paints only --toggle-on-background/foreground. Those fall back to --a63-segment-selected-background, which is surface-overlay in modern.css:32 and surface-panel in aqua.css:93, and the foreground is text-primary, the same as at rest. neutral is the contract's defaultTone, so the default pressed state is invisible: P0 under 'wrong'.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: Toggle's pressed state is conveyed by background colour (neutral/accent) or by text colour alone (subtle), and the system has no forced-colors rules, so the state disappears in Windows High Contrast.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/toggle/toggle.css:137-153; grep -rn forced-colors packages/ui-react/src packages/styles/src returns only a comment at packages/ui-react/src/components/button/button.css:189; no @media (forced-colors) rule exists in the system.
findings.fix: Add @media (forced-colors: active) rules for [data-pressed] (e.g. background: Highlight; color: HighlightText, or a visible border/underline), and give tone=subtle a non-colour cue.

verified.reason: Pressed neutral and accent Toggles change only background-color and color, and subtle changes only color (toggle.css:137-153). A grep of packages and apps finds no @media (forced-colors) rule anywhere. The only hits are comments, changelogs, a CLI rule string and a figma test fixture. In forced colors, author backgrounds and colours are overridden, so pressed and unpressed look the same. aria-pressed still conveys the state to assistive tech, so this is a visual-mode gap (P1), not P0.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: The selected segment loses all visual distinction in forced-colors mode, and toggle-group's roving keyboard focus is not covered by any APG binding or keyboard test.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/toggle-group/toggle-group.css:39-51 (fill and shadow only); apps/storybook/a11y/patterns.test.ts binds 9 components, none of them toggle-group; packages/ui-foundation/contracts/components/toggle-group.json has no accessibility block.
findings.fix: Add forced-colors rules for [data-pressed] segments and bind toggle-group to an APG pattern (toolbar-style roving tabindex) in the contract so patterns.test.ts plays arrow keys against its stories.

verified.reason: toggle-group.css:39-51 marks the selected cell with fill, gloss and shadow only, all of which forced colors drop. The system has no forced-colors rules. patterns.test.ts imports stories for accordion, alert-dialog, checkbox, dialog, dropdown-menu, radio, select, switch and tabs, but not toggle-group. toggle-group.test.tsx (109 lines) has no Arrow, keyboard or focus tests. The toggle-group contract has accessibilityOutcomes but no accessibility pattern binding.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: An active PanelSettingButton differs from an inactive one only by background and border tint, so in forced-colors mode on and off tiles look identical.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/panel-setting-button/panel-setting-button.css:58-70; grep -rn forced-colors packages/ui-react/src packages/styles/src returns only a comment at packages/ui-react/src/components/button/button.css:189; no @media (forced-colors) rule exists in the system.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors rule for [data-active] (Highlight border or background) or a non-colour on-state cue such as a check glyph.

verified.reason: panel-setting-button.css:58-70 makes [data-active] differ only by color-mix tints of action-primary on background, border and foreground. In forced colors, all three become system colours, and the border becomes the same colour as on an inactive tile. No forced-colors rule exists anywhere in the system, so on and off tiles look identical in High Contrast.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: DestinationLink ships no recipe: no class, no link colour or underline, no focus-visible style, no gap before the indicator and no Themes story, so it renders as plain body text in every theme.
findings.evidence: No CSS file in packages/ui-react/src/components/destination-link/; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-destination-link-external-chromium-linux.png; destination-link.stories.tsx:38-39 'which has no Themes matrix'.
findings.fix: Add a .a63-DestinationLink recipe using --a63-text-link (or the link Button tokens), underline in prose, outline focus-visible, logical gap for the indicator, and a Themes story with baselines.

verified.reason: The destination-link directory holds only tsx, test, stories and index files, with no recipe CSS. The component sets no class on the anchor, only data attributes. The external snapshot shows 'View source' as plain body-coloured text with no underline, and the indicator butts against it with no gap. The stories file comments that the component 'has no Themes matrix'. The contract lists focus-visible as a required state, but the system defines no focus style for it (the only :focus-visible in styles/src is os/windows.css). The component doc calls it 'router-neutral link semantics', which partly explains the bare markup, but a stable contract with visualArchetypes 'action' and a required focus-visible state still ships no visual treatment. P1 stands.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Button stamps type="button" and a native disabled attribute on whatever element render supplies, so Button-as-link (Pagination) gets an invalid type on <a> and a disabled that does not block navigation.
findings.fix: Only set type and disabled when the rendered element is a button (Base UI nativeButton pattern); for non-button render, set aria-disabled and drop href handling while disabled.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Starting loading sets native disabled, which drops keyboard focus from the button to the page body.
findings.fix: Keep the button focusable while loading (aria-disabled + click guard, Base UI focusableWhenDisabled) and update the conformance expectation.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: No baseline in this batch captures hover or focus-visible for any component.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-button-states-chromium-linux.png; grep pseudo|focusVisible in component stories finds only textarea.
findings.fix: Add a forced-state story (storybook pseudo-states or data attributes) for hover and focus-visible on Button, Toggle, ToggleGroup, ButtonGroup, CopyButton, PanelSettingButton and DestinationLink.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Button labels never wrap or truncate (white-space: nowrap, no text-overflow), and no long, CJK or RTL story exists for any action component.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/button/button.css:107,262-274; no rtl/long story in button, toggle, toggle-group, button-group stories.
findings.fix: Add ellipsis truncation on .a63-Button-label when the button is width-constrained, and add an RTL + long-label + CJK story to each action component.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Button axes do not line up by name across platforms: iOS tone means neutral|muted|primary|destructive while web tone means neutral|muted, and iOS has 4 sizes against 11 on web.
findings.fix: Decide whether iOS should mirror web names (variant + tone) or web adopt tone/emphasis; then document the mapping table in the contract's Web and iOS section.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: ButtonGroupSeparator always defaults to vertical, so a vertical ButtonGroup draws a vertical hairline unless the caller overrides it; and the group's size axis says 'default' where Button says 'md'.
findings.fix: Read the group orientation from context (as ToggleGroupSeparator does at toggle-group.tsx:98-99) and rename the size value to md with a deprecation alias.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: Docs describe a selected/pressed member fill, but the contract lists only rest and focus-within and no story captures a selected member.
findings.evidence: atom63 component button-group (Key tokens: --a63-segment-selected-background); contract states rest, focus-within.
findings.fix: Add 'selected' (and hover/focus-visible) to the contract states and a story with an aria-pressed member.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: No test covers the separator in a vertical group or focus order across members.
findings.fix: Add tests for vertical separator orientation and Tab order.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: tone="subtle" shows the pressed state by text colour alone, in Toggle and in the segmented ToggleGroup (which has no subtle rule).
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/toggle/toggle.css:151-153; toggle-group.css:39-51 has neutral and accent rules only.
findings.fix: Add a non-colour cue for subtle pressed (e.g. dot or weight) or a measured 3:1 state contrast, and a segmented subtle rule.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: Toggle labels are nowrap and clipped by overflow:hidden with no ellipsis.
findings.fix: Add text-overflow: ellipsis on the content span and a long-label story.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: The Toggle CLI answer is generated boilerplate with irrelevant guidance and no example, and toggle.mdx lists two tones while the contract has three.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 component <slug> output saved during review ('explain errors beside the affected field'); packages/ui-react/src/components/toggle/toggle.mdx:20.
findings.fix: Write real usage guidance and an example into the toggle docs source, and list neutral, accent and subtle.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: Nothing fails when the pressed state is invisible: baselines simply recorded it.
findings.fix: Add a contrast assertion for pressed vs rest (role check or a story-level test) for Toggle, ToggleGroup and PanelSettingButton.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: ToggleGroup takes size and tone props, but its contract declares neither axis, so the CLI and agents cannot see them.
findings.fix: Add sizes and tones (referencing the toggle lists) to toggle-group.json and regenerate.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: A neutral selected segment differs from its neighbours by only 1.04-1.17:1 fill contrast in every theme, and hover on an unselected segment does not change its fill.
findings.fix: Decide whether the segmented convention (thumb + label colour) is enough or raise the selected fill contrast; give hover a distinct fill.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: The segmented variant neither wraps nor scrolls, so a long bar overflows a phone viewport.
findings.fix: Add max-width:100% and overflow-x:auto to the segmented track, as ButtonGroup does, and a phone story.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: AtomGhostToggleGroup uses surfaceMuted for the selected fill where web ghost uses --a63-selected-background, and has no tone or group label.
findings.fix: Use the selected-background token on iOS, add a tone parameter and an accessibility label parameter.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: CopyButton discards a caller's aria-label and title because it spreads props before setting its own.
findings.fix: Spread props last for aria-label/title or derive them from props first (props['aria-label'] ?? ...).

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: With default props the success toast reads 'Copy copied to clipboard', and 'Copied!' and the failure message are hard-coded English with no override.
findings.fix: Default successMessage to 'Copied to clipboard'; add copiedText and errorMessage props.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: The copied state and the failure state have no story or baseline.
findings.evidence: Story list from atom63 component copy-button.
findings.fix: Add a Copied story that renders CopyButtonFeedback copied and a baseline.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: For icon-only use the copied outcome is announced only by an aria-label swap and a toast; without a Toaster nothing is announced.
findings.fix: Render a visually hidden role=status region inside CopyButton for the outcome, independent of the Toaster.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: '(opens in new tab)' is hard-coded English, and the external glyph is not mirrored in RTL.
findings.fix: Add a newTabLabel prop and mirror the indicator under [dir=rtl].

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: iOS destination links use bare arrow glyphs the web component explicitly rejected, and the internal snapshot renders greyed as if disabled.
findings.fix: Use the same open-in-new and eye symbols on iOS and render the snapshot inside a NavigationStack so the internal link is enabled.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: PanelSettingButton never renders its contract slot as data-slot, is controlled-only through a boolean named 'active', and duplicates the tile layout Button now provides as size="tile".
findings.fix: Build on Toggle (pressed/defaultPressed/onPressedChange) or Button size="tile", keep data-slot="panel-setting-button" on the root, and deprecate active.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: The tile's min-height is a literal 4.5rem that ignores density.
findings.fix: Derive it from control height tokens times --a63-density-scale.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: A long tile label overflows because it inherits Button nowrap.
findings.fix: Set white-space: normal and line clamp on .a63-PanelSettingButton-label.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: KbdGroup renders a <div>, which is invalid inside a paragraph and causes a hydration error when used inline in text.
findings.fix: Render KbdGroup as a <kbd> or <span> (shadcn uses <kbd>).

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: kbd.css branches on dark mode and uses a surface token as text colour; both sit in the craft baseline.
findings.evidence: craft-baseline.json entries 'mode-branch | ...kbd.css' and 'token-role | ...kbd.css | color: var(--a63-surface-page)'; kbd.css:50-66.
findings.fix: Add a tooltip-scoped keycap token pair (on-overlay fill and foreground) per mode in the token source and drop the mode selector.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: Symbol keycaps such as ⌘ have no accessible name guidance and are read as 'place of interest sign'.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/kbd/kbd.tsx; CLI answer has no naming guidance.
findings.fix: Document and support aria-label/title on symbol keys (e.g. <Kbd aria-label="Command">⌘</Kbd>) with a story.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: Generated CLI guidance for toggle-group, copy-button, destination-link, panel-setting-button and kbd contains boilerplate that does not apply (form errors, reduced-motion members, destructive behaviour) and no runnable example.
findings.evidence: pnpm -s atom63 component <slug> output saved during review for each slug.
findings.fix: Write component-specific guidance and one example per component in the docs source the CLI reads.

findings.subject: AtomIconButton (iOS)
findings.summary: AtomIconButton still takes the deprecated variant and has no shape or size, so round and small icon buttons cannot be built with it.
findings.fix: Add tone/emphasis, shape and size parameters, deprecate variant, and make the loading label a parameter.

findings.subject: AtomToggle (iOS)
findings.summary: AtomToggle is a switch, while web Toggle is a pressed button mapped to AtomChip; the same name means two different controls.
findings.fix: Decide whether to rename AtomToggle to AtomSwitch (with a deprecated alias) or document the mismatch in both contracts.

findings.subject: AtomButton (iOS)
findings.summary: AtomButton's icon-size comment claims parity with a web min-target floor that the web recipe removed; iOS icon buttons render at 44pt, web at 32px.
findings.fix: Align the comment and decide which platform's icon height is canonical.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: DestinationIndicator accepts only className and kind and does not spread other props.
findings.fix: Accept and spread span props.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: The CLI's Button size table omits tile and the icon-* sizes that the contract lists.
findings.evidence: atom63 component button: table rows xs..xl only.
findings.fix: Add the missing rows to the docs source.
